key.description: Key of a custom question listed in the job context
key.title: Key

ExtractedFields.description: Values stated in the candidate's latest message only. null = not stated in this message.

current_ctc_lpa.description: Current annual CTC in lakhs per annum. '12 lakhs' -> 12; '1.2 crore' -> 120; '80k per month' -> 9.6; '12,00,000' -> 12
current_ctc_lpa.title: Current Ctc Lpa

current_location.description: City or town where the candidate lives now
current_location.title: Current Location

expected_ctc_lpa.description: Expected annual CTC in lakhs per annum
expected_ctc_lpa.title: Expected Ctc Lpa

interested.description: true/false only when clearly stated; 'maybe, depends' -> null
interested.title: Interested

interview_availability.description: When they can interview, in their words
interview_availability.title: Interview Availability

notice_period.description: Notice period in the candidate's words, e.g. '30 days', 'serving notice'
notice_period.title: Notice Period

notice_period_days.description: Notice period in days when derivable; immediate joiner -> 0
notice_period_days.title: Notice Period Days

reason_for_change.description: Why they want to change jobs, briefly
reason_for_change.title: Reason For Change

relevant_experience_years.description: Experience relevant to this role, in years
relevant_experience_years.title: Relevant Experience Years

total_experience_years.description: Total work experience in years. '5 years 6 months' -> 5.5; fresher -> 0
total_experience_years.title: Total Experience Years

ExtractedFields.title: ExtractedFields

field.description: Key of an extracted field or custom question
field.title: Field

quote.description: The candidate's exact words from the latest message
quote.title: Quote

field.description: Numeric field key answered with a range
field.title: Field

callback_time_iso.description: Callback time as ISO 8601 with +05:30 offset, resolved against NOW; null if vague
callback_time_iso.title: Callback Time Iso

callback_time_text.description: Callback time in the candidate's words
callback_time_text.title: Callback Time Text

candidate_question.description: Question the candidate asked, if any
candidate_question.title: Candidate Question

confirmed_fields.description: Fields whose value the candidate just affirmed when asked to confirm
confirmed_fields.title: Confirmed Fields

declined_fields.description: Fields the candidate refused to share
declined_fields.title: Declined Fields

evidence.description: One quote per non-null extracted value
evidence.title: Evidence

identity_confirmed.description: Only for the identity question: true = it's them, false = wrong person
identity_confirmed.title: Identity Confirmed

next_question.description: Key of the field your reply asks about
next_question.title: Next Question

opt_out.description: Candidate asked never to be called or to remove the number
opt_out.title: Opt Out

permission_granted.description: Only for 'is this a good time': true = go ahead, false = not now
permission_granted.title: Permission Granted

ranges.description: Numeric answers given as a range ('15 to 18 lakhs'); leave the value null
ranges.title: Ranges

response_text.description: What you say next: spoken, at most two sentences
response_text.title: Response Text

unknown_fields.description: Fields the candidate says they don't know
unknown_fields.title: Unknown Fields
